transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We need immediate, widespread genomic surveillance and testing to determine true severity and transmission rates before committing to costlier interventions.

actions.rationale: We need immediate, widespread genomic surveillance and testing to determine true severity and transmission rates before committing to costlier interventions.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: We must preemptively surge production of PPE, tests, and ventilators so we are not caught short if this escalates.

actions.rationale: We must preemptively surge production of PPE, tests, and ventilators so we are not caught short if this escalates.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: I will give daily, data-driven briefings to level with the American people about what we know, what we don't, and how we are preparing.

actions.rationale: I will give daily, data-driven briefings to level with the American people about what we know, what we don't, and how we are preparing.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need to work with Congress now to secure emergency funding and statutory authority for whatever steps may be required next.

actions.rationale: We need to work with Congress now to secure emergency funding and statutory authority for whatever steps may be required next.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: A crash public-private program for vaccines and therapeutics must begin immediately given the long development timelines.

actions.rationale: A crash public-private program for vaccines and therapeutics must begin immediately given the long development timelines.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: I will mandate masking in federal jurisdictions and urge governors to adopt a national standard as a low-cost measure to slow potential spread while we gather data.

actions.rationale: I will mandate masking in federal jurisdictions and urge governors to adopt a national standard as a low-cost measure to slow potential spread while we gather data.

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard will give the public and markets real-time information to combat rumor and panic.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard will give the public and markets real-time information to combat rumor and panic.

Economy index 100/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 3/100. Restriction level 0.2/10.
